key.name: empty-selection
key.summary: What to do when nothing is selected
key.description: auto: select to the paragraph start (Ctrl+Shift+Up) and convert; ask: ask first; none: do nothing.

key.name: copy-timeout
key.summary: How long to wait for copied text (ms)
key.description: If Ctrl+C copies nothing within this time, the selection is treated as empty. Lower is faster; raise it if slow apps are wrongly treated as having no selection.

key.name: fast-mode
key.description: Detects the copy as soon as the app sets the clipboard, learns how fast each app copies and shortens the wait to match, and skips the pauses between the no-selection fallback steps.

key.name: copy-times
key.description: The slowest Ctrl+C seen in each app while fast mode is on. Used to shorten the selection wait time.

key.name: skip-words
key.default: 'aws, bits, bots, box, cart, chart, churn, core, cost, dart, data, deep, desk, disk, dist, docs, erp, hook, host, iaas, kafka, loop, mark, mask, meet, mix, next, nginx, nuxt, okr, paas, pair, par, peer, port, pos, queries, queue, ref, res, root, rows, saas, sort, task, tax, term, test, text, ux'
key.summary: English words to leave untouched (comma-separated, prefix match)

key.name: language
key.description: auto: follow the system locale; en: English; vi: Vietnamese.
